tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Petrol. Headers, primary buttons, links, focus rings. The white-label slot: a customer's color replaces this token only.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. White on petrol is 7.7:1; in dark mode the fill is light, so text is near-black.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand surfaces: selected rows, active nav item, info banners. Body text in ink sits on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Streaks, highlights, celebrations and the one call to action that matters on a screen. Never more than one accent CTA per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on saffron. Always ink, never white, in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft saffron ground for streak cards and reward moments. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Slate. Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Warm paper. App and portal background.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, quiz question panels, table bodies. Separated from the page by a 1px border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs at rest, progress tracks, code and inset areas.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, unselected answer options, checkboxes. Meets 3:1 on surface-page, surface-card and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: feedback-correct
tokens.usage: Correct answer. Always paired with a ✓ icon and the label 'Correct'. Reserved: never a brand or decorative color.

tokens.name: feedback-correct-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a correct answer option or result banner; text on it is ink, icon and label in feedback-correct.

tokens.name: feedback-wrong
tokens.usage: Wrong answer. Always paired with a ✗ icon and the label 'Not quite'. Reserved: never a brand or decorative color.

tokens.name: feedback-wrong-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a wrong answer option or result banner; text on it is ink, icon and label in feedback-wrong.

tokens.name: feedback-learning
tokens.usage: Still learning / partial mastery. Always paired with a ◐ icon and the label 'Still learning'. Kept darker than saffron so it never reads as the accent.

tokens.name: feedback-learning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a still-learning chip or banner; ink text, icon and label in feedback-learning.

tokens.name: on-feedback
tokens.usage: Text on a solid feedback fill (e.g. a filled 'Correct' pill).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Celebration screens and the portal's hero numbers.

styles.name: title-2
styles.sample: Which temperature keeps chilled food safe?
styles.usage: Quiz questions, card titles, section headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Store raw meat on the bottom shelf, below ready-to-eat food.
styles.usage: Answer options and the explanation after an answer (mobile).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Anna has completed 18 of 24 procedures this month.
styles.usage: Default body text in the app and portal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels, feedback labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Progress counters only ("Question 3 of 5"). Sentence case, never a decorative eyebrow above a headline.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; inner padding of small pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between answer options; compact button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; default stack gap; mobile screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections in the portal.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large separations and celebration-screen breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline tags, focus-ring offset corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The house radius: buttons, inputs, cards, answer options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, celebration panels, the push-notification card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: streak badge, feedback chips, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Only for things that float over content: bottom sheets, menus, the answer-result sheet. Resting cards use a border, never border plus shadow.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Routine UI: hover, press, color changes, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: The answer moment only: result sheet rising, streak milestone scaling in. Set to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The only easing. No bounce or elastic curves.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Phone to tablet. Below this, single column and 16px gutters. Use in media queries as a literal (CSS vars can't be used in @media).

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Manager portal: sidebar plus content. Content never wider than 1120px.
